messages:
elaine: raising a PR to add Asteria-13B to the model catalog. includes limits, a short migration note from Asteria-7B, and a performance blurb. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/13105
sam: can you include both a minimal py v2 and js example? product says copy-pasteable is a must.
marco: did a quick bench run this morning, will paste median/p95 tokens-per-second for gpu-fp, gpu-quant, and cpu-quant (4k). linking gist: https://gist.github.com/marco/asteria-13b-bench
elaine: drop the key examples here in the thread so reviewers can see them quickly.
elaine: python example:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = client.generate(model="asteria-13b", prompt="Summarize the meeting notes", max_tokens=250)
print(resp.text)
```
marco: js streaming example (small):
```javascript
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
const stream = await client.stream({ model: 'asteria-13b-long' })
stream.send('Write a one-paragraph summary of the docs')
for await (const chunk of stream) console.log(chunk.delta)
```
rik: runtime note: asteria-13b-long is region-gated and maps to different GPU families; please add a compatibility line about per-region availability.
olivia: product wants a one-line performance summary inline in the card, not just a gist. can we paste p50/p95 numbers measured at 1024 tokens?
marco: pasted compact perf line into PR: "gpu-fp: p50 85ms (140 tps), p95 140ms (95 tps); gpu-quant: p50 110ms (110 tps), p95 185ms (70 tps); cpu-quant (4k): p50 1100ms (7 tps), p95 2100ms (4 tps)"
sam: add parenthetical: "measurements at 1k context; longer contexts reduce tps" to avoid follow-ups.
anya: infra flagged ambiguous anchors: the card links to /models/asteria-13b#variants but our template now uses /models/asteria-13b/variants. will break link-checker. please fix before merging.
elaine: I'll update the PR to use canonical anchor /models/asteria-13b/variants and add a short redirect frontmatter so older links still work.
marco: runtime also asks for a short YAML fallback example so support can point customers to it. adding small snippet in the card.
marco: YAML fallback snippet:
```yaml
fallback_policy:
  preferred: asteria-13b-long (gpu)
  fallback: asteria-13b-quant-cpu
  cpu-quant-max-context: 4096
```
rik: also add a one-liner under Compatibility: "cpu-quant may OOM above 8k; for production long contexts use GPU-backed long variants or Dedicated capacity."
olivia: can you also mention token-counting behavior? customers confuse prompt vs total token limits. a tiny example helps.
elaine: added quick example: "prompt 1,500 tokens + max_tokens 500 => total 2,000 tokens; requests over max_total_tokens return 413."
marco: pushed a tiny CSV with bench raw rows to the PR and copied the median/p95 inline as requested.
docs-bot: preview deployed for PR 13105: https://deploy.preview.redwood/docs/changes/13105  link-checker: 1 broken link -> /models/asteria-13b/variants (now fixed in PR)
sam: small SDK copy note: include stream vs generate guidance: "use stream for interactive UIs; use generate with batching for bulk async jobs."
elaine: ok plan: wait for anya to confirm redirect/frontmatter fix then merge. thanks all! :tada:
